name: EA_High_and_Low_last_24_hours
summary: This EA identifies the highest and lowest prices over the last 24 hours and trades breakouts beyond those levels. It enters long when price breaks above the 24-hour high and enters short when price breaks below the 24-hour low, aiming to capture momentum from range expansions.
summary_zh: 该EA识别过去24小时的最高价和最低价，并在价格突破这些水平时进行交易。当价格突破24小时高点时做多，突破24小时低点时做空，旨在捕捉区间扩展带来的动量行情。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于24小时区间突破，即价格突破前一日的最高价或最低价时顺势入场。入场条件为：当前价格向上突破过去24小时最高价时开多单，向下突破过去24小时最低价时开空单。出场条件依赖于止损和止盈设置，但具体参数需从外部输入获取。仓位管理采用固定手数方式，未根据账户资金动态调整仓位大小。资金管理方面缺乏对最大持仓数量的限制，也没有浮亏保护机制。整体策略逻辑简单直接，属于经典的日内突破策略，但缺乏过滤条件和多重确认机制，容易在假突破行情中产生亏损。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on a 24-hour range breakout, entering trades when price breaks above the daily high or below the daily low. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the current price breaks above the highest price of the last 24 hours, and a short position is opened when price breaks below the lowest price of the last 24 hours. Exit conditions rely on stop loss and take profit levels, which are configurable through input parameters. Position sizing uses a fixed lot size approach without dynamic scaling based on account equity or volatility. Money management lacks safeguards such as maximum position count limits, floating loss protection, or equity drawdown controls. The overall strategy is a straightforward classic intraday breakout system, but it lacks filtering conditions and multi-confirmation mechanisms, making it vulnerable to false breakout signals that can lead to consecutive losses.

parameters.name: TakeProfit
parameters.description_en: Take profit in points; close on cumulative profit

parameters.name: MagicNumber
parameters.description: EA魔术编号，用于识别本EA的订单
parameters.description_en: Magic number; 0 to manage all orders

parameters.name: LookbackHours
parameters.description: 回溯小时数，用于计算最高最低价

pros: 策略逻辑简单明了，易于理解和调试
24小时高低点突破是经典有效的技术分析方法
参数可配置，用户可以根据不同市场环境调整止损止盈和回溯周期
pros_en: Strategy logic is simple and clear, easy to understand and debug
24-hour high/low breakout is a proven and classic technical analysis approach
Configurable parameters allow users to adjust stop loss, take profit, and lookback period for different market conditions
cons: 缺乏假突破过滤机制，容易在震荡行情中被反复止损
固定手数不根据账户资金和波动率动态调整，资金管理不够灵活
没有持仓数量限制和最大浮亏保护，存在连续亏损导致大回撤的风险
缺少新K线检查机制，可能在同一根K线上重复开仓
cons_en: Lacks false breakout filtering mechanism, prone to repeated stop-outs in ranging markets
Fixed lot size does not dynamically adjust based on account equity or volatility, making money management inflexible
No position count limit or maximum floating loss protection, risking significant drawdown from consecutive losses
Missing new bar check mechanism, potentially opening multiple positions on the same bar
improvements: 添加ATR或波动率过滤，避免在低波动震荡行情中入场
引入动态仓位计算，根据账户余额和ATR自动调整手数大小
增加最大持仓数量限制和账户浮亏保护机制
添加新K线检查，防止同一根K线上重复开仓
improvements_en: Add ATR or volatility filter to avoid entering trades during low-volatility ranging conditions
Introduce dynamic position sizing that automatically adjusts lot size based on account balance and ATR
Add maximum position count limits and account floating loss protection mechanisms
Implement new bar check to prevent duplicate entries on the same candle

risk_points: 缺少假突破过滤，震荡市中容易连续止损
没有最大持仓限制和浮亏保护，极端行情下可能产生大额亏损
固定手数无法适应不同账户规模和波动环境
risk_points_en: No false breakout filter, prone to consecutive stop-outs in choppy markets
No maximum position limit or floating loss protection, risking large losses during extreme market conditions
Fixed lot size cannot adapt to different account sizes and volatility environments

summary_en: This EA identifies the highest and lowest prices over the last 24 hours and trades breakouts beyond those levels. It enters long when price breaks above the 24-hour high and enters short when price breaks below the 24-hour low, aiming to capture momentum from range expansions.
